environment: omnix-portrait conda env from services/portrait/portrait.lock.txt; the service alone on a free local port (no gateway, TTS or STT); started after scripts/portrait_spike.py busy_reasons found no RPG gate or model service for a minute
inputs: photo upstream sam_altman.webp (uncropped); audio voice_clones/Maya.wav (10.64 s, 24 kHz) sent in 80 ms blocks at 3x real time; speculation: its first 2 s as speculative audio, bound 1 s later; preview: its first 4 s
notes: idle seam_mean_abs is the mean absolute pixel change (0-255) from the loop's last frame back to its first; neighbour_median is the median change between neighbouring idle frames (80 ms apart). The seam is about 3x a normal step: a small visible jump every 4.3 s.
first_frame_ms (level 0) is from the reply's first audio block to its first frame, with the model warm.
